description: Precise edits with Ideogram 4.5: change exactly what you describe, optionally inside a mask, guided by up to three reference images. Compared with other image tools: premium. Price: from $0.012 per image, charged only on success. Price depends on quality: very_low $0.012, low $0.042, medium $0.082, high $0.298 (default medium). One call = one image.
